name: ASTRA REAL_DATA RESEARCH
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/research-real.yml"
      - "scripts/research_real_data_ci.py"
      - "data/real/**"
      - "evidence/real_data_ci.json"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  research:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/research_real_data_ci.py
      - name: Persist research evidence
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add evidence/real_data_research_ci.json
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "evidence(astra): persist real-data research run [skip ci]"
          git push

name: ASTRA REAL_DATA CANDIDATE RESEARCH
# Re-run candidate tournament after selection-score fix
# Triggered on candidate-script corrections and evidence validation
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/research-candidates-real.yml"
      - "scripts/research_candidate_real_ci.py"
      - "data/real/**"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  research:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/research_candidate_real_ci.py
      - name: Persist candidate evidence
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add evidence/real_data_candidate_research_ci.json
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "evidence(astra): persist multi-family real-data candidate research [skip ci]"
          git push

name: ASTRA REAL_DATA CANDIDATE RESEARCH REPAIR
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["ASTRA REAL_DATA CANDIDATE RESEARCH"]
    types: [completed]
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  repair-research:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/multi_asset_real_ci.py
      - run: python scripts/research_candidate_real_ci.py
      - run: python scripts/cross_asset_research_ci.py
      - name: Persist candidate evidence
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/real/kraken_*_1d.csv evidence/multi_asset_real_data_ci.json evidence/real_data_candidate_research_ci.json evidence/cross_asset_research_ci.json
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "evidence(astra): persist corrected candidate research [skip ci]"
          git push

name: ASTRA PRINCIPLED HYPOTHESIS TEST
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ["scripts/principled_hypothesis_test_ci.py","astra/**","data/real/**",".github/workflows/principled-hypothesis.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: "3.13"}
      - run: python scripts/principled_hypothesis_test_ci.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: astra-principled-hypothesis-evidence
          path: evidence/principled_hypothesis_test_ci.json

name: ASTRA RECONCILIATION KILL SWITCH
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "astra/execution/safety.py"
      - "tests/test_execution_safety.py"
      - "scripts/reconciliation_killswitch_ci.py"
      - ".github/workflows/reconciliation-killswitch.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  reconciliation-killswitch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_execution_safety.py" -v
      - run: python scripts/reconciliation_killswitch_ci.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: astra-reconciliation-killswitch-evidence
          path: evidence/reconciliation_killswitch_ci.json

name: ASTRA CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip pytest
      - run: pytest -q

  candidate-real-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/research_candidate_real_ci.py
      - run: python scripts/cross_asset_research_ci.py
      - name: Archive research evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: astra-real-data-research-evidence
          path: |
            evidence/real_data_candidate_research_ci.json
            evidence/cross_asset_research_ci.json

  execution-boundary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_kraken_execution.py" -v
      - run: python scripts/execution_boundary_check.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: astra-execution-boundary-evidence
          path: evidence/execution_boundary_check.json

name: ASTRA EXCHANGE TEST

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "astra/execution/**"
      - "scripts/exchange_test_ci.py"
      - ".github/workflows/exchange-test.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  exchange-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Test Kraken public exchange boundary
        run: python scripts/exchange_test_ci.py
      - name: Archive evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: astra-exchange-test-evidence
          path: evidence/exchange_test_ci.json

name: ASTRA PROSPECTIVE PAPER VALIDATION
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "scripts/prospective_paper_validation_ci.py"
      - ".github/workflows/prospective-paper-validation.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 0 * * *"
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  prospective-paper:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/prospective_paper_validation_ci.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: astra-prospective-paper-validation
          path: evidence/prospective_paper_validation_ci.json
